If we exclude those invoices, the eligible receivables balance drops from the proposed $8.5 million to exactly $7.2 million. Additionally, as a required closing control, the closing file must include a signed assignment-consent package for both KITE and NORTHSTAR customers. I have not yet uploaded this review to the transaction folder, but I wanted to flag it immediately in this review round.
